meta.title: Website to Mobile App Conversion Proposal | Web-App
meta.description: Turn your existing responsive website into an Android and iOS mobile app with WebView shells, push notifications, and native features.

hero.tagline: Mobile app conversion · Android & iOS WebView & Hybrid
hero.headline: Turn your existing website into a high-performance mobile app.
hero.subheading: A fast, cost-effective route to publish your responsive website onto the Google Play Store and Apple App Store with native push notifications, deep links, and device capabilities.

sections.heading: The mobile conversion opportunity
sections.subheading: Take advantage of your existing website to launch a mobile app in weeks rather than months.
sections.introSuffix: already has a functioning web presence. Rather than investing in a costly ground-up rebuild, converting your website into a hybrid mobile app allows you to engage mobile users with push notifications, icon presence, and native speed.

outcomes.title: 1-Tap Home Screen Presence
outcomes.desc: Give customers instant access with a branded app icon on their home screen, boosting recurring visits and brand recall.

outcomes.title: Real-Time Push Notifications
outcomes.desc: Send instant alerts for flash sales, order updates, new content, and announcements directly to users' lock screens with 90%+ open rates.

outcomes.title: Fast Time-to-Market & Lower Cost
outcomes.desc: Launch on Google Play and Apple App Store in as little as 1 to 4 weeks at a fraction of the cost of building from scratch.

sections.heading: Complimentary mobile feasibility check
sections.subheading: Two zero-risk resources provided to assess your website's readiness for App Store conversion.

cards.title: Website Mobile-Readiness & UX Review
cards.desc: We test your existing website across multiple Android and iOS device viewports to verify compatibility.
items: Review of mobile touch navigation, sticky headers, and input fields
Check for external link handling and authentication session persistence
Assessment of Apple App Store Guideline 4.2 (Minimum Functionality compliance)
Written readiness checklist with recommendations before packaging

cards.title: 20-Min Test App Preview & Walkthrough
cards.desc: Experience your website loaded inside a native container on a real smartphone.
items: Live demo of splash screen animation and smooth status bar integration
Walkthrough of push notification dashboard and deep link testing
Explanation of Google Play and Apple Developer account enrollment
Q&A session to confirm feature scope and launch milestones

sections.footer: Free assessments are available for active businesses, e-commerce stores, news portals, and community sites.

sections.heading: Choose your mobile conversion tier
sections.subheading: Three progressive tiers matching the exact deliverables and timeframes required for your app experience.

tiers.title: The "Wrapper" (Starter)
tiers.desc: A sleek native shell that packages your mobile website into an installable Android and iOS application.
items: App icon design & branded splash loading screen
Basic WebView shell (optimally loads and caches the website)
Smooth native navigation & Android physical back-button handling
Pull-to-refresh & offline network connection detector screen
Basic cross-device testing across common screen resolutions
Store submission assistance & signed release bundle (.aab / .ipa)
14 days post-launch warranty and verification support
tiers.footNote: Best for content sites, blogs, and simple catalogs that want fast App Store availability.

tiers.recommendLabel: Recommended for active stores & member portals
tiers.title: The "Native Feel" (Plus)
tiers.desc: Everything in Starter plus real-time push notifications, deep links, and seamless user account persistence.
items: Everything included in the Starter "Wrapper" package
Push notifications setup with Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) & web push backend
Deep links support (opening shared links navigates directly to specific in-app pages)
Improved login handling (persistent cookies and biometric keychain storage)
Basic in-app analytics & crash reporting setup (Google Analytics / Crashlytics)
Custom native bottom navigation bar for quick access to primary sections
30 days post-launch warranty and push broadcast training
tiers.footNote: Engineered to keep users coming back with automated notifications and smooth in-app navigation.

tiers.title: The "Hybrid" (Advanced)
tiers.desc: A hybrid architecture blending your website with custom native device screens and offline capabilities.
items: Everything included in the Plus "Native Feel" package
Custom native screens (e.g., native camera capture, GPS geolocation, file uploaders)
Offline caching (key screens and cached data display smoothly without internet)
Additional API integrations & JavaScript-to-Native bridge handlers
Biometric authentication (Fingerprint / Face ID login lock)
Expanded QA testing across multiple OS versions and screen aspect ratios
Comprehensive store rejection protection & Apple Guideline 4.2 compliance defense
60 days dedicated technical warranty and priority support
tiers.footNote: For businesses requiring hardware access (camera, location, biometrics) and offline reliability.

enterprise.heading: Enterprise Multi-Store & White-Label Deployments
enterprise.body: For organizations requiring custom internal distribution, mobile device management (MDM) deployment, multi-tenant white-label branding, or dedicated continuous integration / continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.

sections.smallNote: All packages include complete source code ownership. Apple Developer ($99/year) and Google Play Console ($25 one-time) fees are paid directly to Apple and Google.

sections.heading: Popular conversion add-ons
sections.subheading: Optional enhancements to elevate your mobile application.

tiers.title: Biometric Face ID & Fingerprint Login
tiers.desc: Allow users to unlock the app and authenticate securely using their phone's fingerprint sensor or Face ID.
items: Native iOS Face ID / Touch ID integration
Android BiometricPrompt API integration
Fallback to account password or PIN code
Encrypted secure token storage on device
tiers.footNote: Greatly enhances user security and login speed for financial, medical, or account-based apps.

tiers.title: App Store Optimization (ASO) Pack
tiers.desc: Maximize organic downloads with professional App Store & Google Play screenshots, keywords, and copy.
items: 5 custom branded device mockup preview screenshots for iPhone and Android
Keyword-optimized app title, subtitle, and detailed marketing description
High-resolution App Store icon and promotional feature banners
Localized Ghanaian search tags to rank for relevant industry searches
tiers.footNote: Ensures your app looks prestigious and ranks well when potential customers search the stores.

sections.smallNote: Add-ons can be selected during the initial conversion or deployed as phase-two updates.

sections.heading: Conversion tier comparison matrix
sections.subheading: A clear side-by-side view of features, technical deliverables, and support across all three tiers.
rows: Branded App Icon & Custom Splash Screen
Deep Linking to Specific Pages / Products
sections.footnote: Both Google Play Store (Android) and Apple App Store (iOS) publishing are supported across all tiers.

sections.heading: Ongoing app care & growth services
sections.subheading: Services to ensure your mobile apps remain fast, secure, and compatible with new phone models.

items.title: Developer Account Enrollment Assistance
items.body: We guide your organization step-by-step through setting up verified Apple Developer ($99/yr) and Google Play Console ($25 one-time) accounts.

items.title: Push Notification Marketing Campaigns
items.body: Assistance designing automated push notification sequences for abandoned carts, weekly promotions, or breaking announcements.

items.title: In-App Review & Rating Prompts
items.body: Smart native rating dialogs that trigger after positive customer milestones to generate 5-star reviews on the stores.

items.title: Annual OS Compatibility Updates
items.body: Quarterly SDK upgrades and testing to guarantee your apps run smoothly on the latest Android and iOS operating system releases.

sections.footer: Care plans can be retained monthly or booked on an as-needed basis for major seasonal updates.

sections.heading: Four-step conversion process
sections.subheading: From initial website inspection to live App Store availability in 1 to 4 weeks.

steps.title: Website Audit & Asset Prep
steps.desc: We inspect your website responsiveness, optimize viewport scaling, and collect your high-res logo artwork for app icons and splash screens.

steps.title: App Shell Engineering
steps.desc: We configure the native wrapper container, integrate navigation controllers, set up push notification SDKs, and build test builds.

steps.title: Testing & Client Preview
steps.desc: We install test builds on your team's real Android and iOS phones to test touch response, links, logins, and push notifications.

steps.title: Store Submission & Launch
steps.desc: We prepare store screenshots, privacy policy links, and descriptions, then submit the signed release bundles for Google Play and Apple approval.

sections.heading: Commercial terms and commitments
sections.subheading: Transparent milestone schedule, clear ownership, and reliable warranty terms.

terms.title: Milestone payments
terms.body: 50% upfront commitment to initiate packaging and asset design, 30% upon approval of the live test build on your phone, and 20% prior to final store release.

terms.title: 100% Code & Store Account Ownership
terms.body: Apps are published directly under your company's official developer accounts. You maintain complete ownership of all code, assets, and user data.

terms.title: Store Approval Support Guarantee
terms.body: We assist and handle technical feedback from Google Play and Apple review teams until your application is successfully published.

terms.title: Post-Launch Warranty
terms.body: Includes complimentary bug fixing, crash monitoring, and technical support following store release based on your chosen tier.

callout.label: Store Requirements Notice:
callout.body: Apple and Google require organizations to hold registered developer accounts. Websites must be mobile-friendly and comply with standard App Store guidelines.

sections.heading: Next steps to launch your mobile app
sections.subheading: Let's bring your website to the App Store and Google Play with speed and polish.
paragraphs: We recommend The "Native Feel" (Plus) tier at GH₵3,000 – 6,000 for active businesses wanting to engage their customer base with lock-screen push notifications, deep linking, and smooth session persistence. For simple portfolios or blogs wanting fast store presence, The "Wrapper" (Starter) at GH₵1,500 – 2,500 delivers rapid 1–2 week deployment.
To get started, simply reply to confirm your preferred tier or schedule your complimentary 20-minute feasibility check.
